_what: Per-code adjudication of the 39 KBLI the catalogue published as CHIUSO_PMA_NO_BESAR.
_method: 8 research lanes on primary sources + 8 refute lanes on fresh context, then graded by Codex GPT-5.6 (terra, high). Three verdicts the grader would not accept are recorded in the report's Adversarial review section and are NOT silently reconciled here: 86995 (decisive Permenkes annex image-only and unread), 38110 (no local Bali instrument read for any code), 95291 (crosswalk splits it; high confidence not earned).
_vintage: Perpres 10/2021 as amended by 49/2021, both Berlaku (verified 2026-08-03 by direct fetch of peraturan.bpk.go.id Details/161806 and Details/168534, HTTP 200).
_declared_limit: No investment instrument has ever been re-issued in KBLI-2025 numbering, so every 2025-numbered verdict here runs through the BPS conversion table — a statistical artefact with no legal force.

_verdicts.RESERVED: named in Perpres 49/2021 Lampiran II 'dialokasikan' column — a PT PMA cannot take it
_verdicts.PARTIAL: reserved only as to a NAMED sub-activity (Perpres 10/2021 Pasal 5(5) scopes the reservation to the wording in the Bidang Usaha column); the rest of the code is not
_verdicts.REQUIREMENT: a real located requirement that is NOT an ownership rule — a PT PMA can satisfy it
_verdicts.PARTNERSHIP: a partnership duty, which does not bar foreign ownership
_verdicts.NONE: no restriction located in Lampiran I/II/III, the closed list, or any sectoral instrument read in this pass
